stages.command: install exact manifest clients; verify readiness, identity, auth, profiles and tools/list
honua admin connection create/test; import; publish/configure layer and access policy
honua_get_style; honua_apply_style_preset; honua_render_map; validate decoded PNG
discover/run geometry.buffer; wait/cancel canonical job; retain result
submit and poll durable AwaitingApproval proposal bound to item/version/hash
honua admin operate approveOperationProposal --profile approver --yes; poll published URL

notes: `clientCommands` names the terminal commands each stage needs from the pinned #136 clientArtifacts. A stage whose command is not shipped by the pinned bytes is blocked on honua-release#7 regardless of server readiness.

Command providers describe the expected package. The per-run integrity-verified commandSurface, including a successful `honua --help` probe for `admin`, determines presence; metadata cannot prove execution of credentialed or mutating verbs.

Stage evidence is keyed on the identities the server emits (`stageEvidenceKeys`). Stages 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8 go through the operation gateway and must carry operationId/operationInstanceId/correlationId/auditId (honua-server OperationExecutionModels); stages 7-8 also proposalId. Approval is keyed on proposalId + resolvedBy + the approved replay's auditId.

Stage 5 (bounded GP) runs on the job runtime, not the operation gateway: honua_execute_plan returns {jobId, status, createdAt, resourceUri} and no operation identities. A passing stage 5 is therefore keyed on jobId + resourceUri + jobStatus + jobCreatedAt as submitted, and the canonical job lifecycle check reads that jobId back.

Stage 3 imports through the admin multipart upload (`honua admin import uploadImportFile`, POST /api/v1/admin/import/upload) of the committed fixture GeoJSON, then publishes the imported table through honua_publish_service (canonical service.publish). The GeoServices URL import is not used locally: GeoservicesServiceUrlValidation requires HTTPS and rejects private-network hosts with no operator opt-in.

`receiptOptional` fields are nullable receipt fields. policyDecisionId, approvalId, actuatorId and verificationId are kept for compatibility with earlier receipts; no Honua candidate emits them, so they are never required and never invented. jobId, resourceUri, jobStatus and jobCreatedAt carry the stage 5 job evidence and are null on other stages.
`blockedBy` lists the upstream contracts a stage waits on. It is contract metadata; the live driver derives the authoritative per-run blocker set from its own probes.
